name: Product
pitch: A launch-day talk for a developer tool, where every slide should feel like the landing page of something you want to install.

illustration.medium: flat vector, clean SaaS-landing-page illustration on off-white
illustration.line: 2px rounded strokes, consistent corner radius, friendly not sharp
illustration.shapes: rounded rectangles, soft blobs, pill buttons, simple isometric-free devices and icons
illustration.texture: none, flat color fields with occasional soft drop shadow for depth
illustration.palette_use: white and near-white dominant, single deep green accent used for the one call-to-action element
illustration.avoid: hand-drawn wobble, grunge texture, heavy black outlines, clutter
